title: Local Disordered Region Sampling (LDRS) for Ensemble Modeling of Proteins with Experimentally Undetermined or Low Confidence Prediction Segments.
authors: Liu, Zi Hao; Teixeira, Joao M C; Zhang, Oufan; Tsangaris, Thomas E; Li, Jie; Gradinaru, Claudiu C; Head-Gordon, Teresa; Forman-Kay, Julie D
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍LDRS工具，用于为蛋白结构中无序区域生成全原子构象系综，虽聚焦IDR构象建模而非直接PPI机制，但方法可迁移至无序蛋白互作复合物的构象采样。
abstract: The Local Disordered Region Sampling (LDRS, pronounced loaders) tool, developed for the IDPConformerGenerator platform (Teixeira et al. 2022), provides a method for generating all-atom conformations of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) at N- and C-termini of and in loops or linkers between folded regions of an existing protein structure. These disordered elements often lead to missing coordinates in experimental structures or low confidence in predicted structures. Requiring only a pre-existing PDB structure of the protein with missing coordinates or with predicted confidence scores and its full-length primary sequence, LDRS will automatically generate physically meaningful conformational ensembles of the missing flexible regions to complete the full-length protein. The capabilities of the LDRS tool of IDPConformerGenerator include modeling phosphorylation sites using enhanced Monte Carlo Side Chain Entropy (MC-SCE) (Bhowmick and Head-Gordon 2015), transmembrane proteins within an all-atom bilayer, and multi-chain complexes. The modeling capacity of LDRS capitalizes on the modularity, ability to be used as a library and via command-line, and computational speed of the IDPConformerGenerator platform.
abstract_zh: 为IDPConformerGenerator平台（Teixeira等，2022）开发的局部无序区域采样（LDRS，读作loaders）工具，提供了一种方法，用于在现有蛋白质结构的N端、C端以及折叠区域之间的环或连接子中，生成 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 的全原子构象。这些无序元件常导致实验结构中坐标缺失或预测结构置信度低。仅需预先存在的蛋白质PDB结构（含缺失坐标或预测置信度分数）及其全长一级序列，LDRS即可自动生成缺失柔性区域的物理意义构象集合，以完成全长蛋白质。IDPConformerGenerator的LDRS工具能力包括：使用增强型蒙特卡洛侧链熵（MC-SCE）（Bhowmick和Head-Gordon 2015）建模磷酸化位点、全原子双层中的跨膜蛋白，以及多链复合物。LDRS的建模能力得益于IDPConformerGenerator平台的模块化特性、可作为库及通过命令行使用的能力，以及计算速度。
